scope: Independent source/metadata review and temporary-fixture tests only; no patient/source-surface arrays, native mesher, solver, landmarks or model execution.
reviewed_contracts: Exact seven-file archived Git/source closure, exact output directory, and unauthorized template fail closed.
Five hash-bound context roles and prior failed-v1 worker bind the declared saved native-surface hash; no image re-extraction path.
Fixed one-candidate helper and unchanged quality/fidelity/count settings; no retries, continued levels or solver admission.
Original private Gmsh module/library bindings, package versions, one numerical thread and sequential VTK; no ambient native import in reviewed controls.
Reviewed process-group supervisor receives 180-second and 3-GiB caps; injected output-observer failure reaches its failure path and original observer is restored.
8-MiB sampled aggregate/32-file/depth-four output guard, child-local 4-MiB hard per-file limit before saved-array loading, and unchanged 2-MiB complete diagnostic packet.
Exact saved-array keys and allow_pickle=False; mocked worker rejects unexpected arrays and solver admission.
Candidate output hashes, source/input checks after execution, failure receipts and post-publication acceptance cap check.

findings.finding: Final acceptance publication could cross output byte/file caps after the last pre-publication check.
findings.kind: static finding repaired before independent reproduction
findings.resolution: Caller rechecks output after writing acceptance and forces failed status on an overrun.
findings.controls: Independent near-byte-cap and near-file-count boundary controls passed; output-closeout-controls-after-repair.txt records the first independent execution.

findings.finding: Owner atomic-publication fixture raised FileNotFoundError without ordinary ENOENT.
findings.kind: owner test setup failure, not product/native failure
findings.resolution: Owner corrected the fixture and retained its original log in the owner preparation directory.

limitations: No actual candidate was generated; no new count, fidelity, quality, anatomy, solver or performance result is claimed.
Aggregate output and RSS are sampled, not atomic quotas or exact peaks; an overrun may be detected after it occurs.
Hard per-file limits apply in the child; parent failure metadata may remain after a cap failure, and an over-cap attempt cannot report success.
Selected runtime module/library hashes and package versions are checked; this is not complete dependency-binary attestation.
The retained estimated domain has known inferior/cerebellar exclusions and is not an accepted whole-brain or pial surface.
The 6000-node/6000-tet limit concerns mesh preparation only; it does not authorize or predict patient-solver memory or accuracy.
A committed source archive and a separate exact root release are required before any real attempt.
